source.notice:
# Original source

Project-authored synthetic package catalog and dependency solver, fixed candidate version `2026-10-25-v0.1.1`. Package IDs, version rows, feature flags, bounds, scoring rule, conflict rule, fixtures, gold and independent reference are original to this task. No npm/pip/Cargo registry data, public benchmark item, external solver code or private validation set is copied. Harbor packaging convention is reused. Publication license is pending project-owner decision (`project-license-pending`). Business computation is offline. Revision 0.1.1 sets `allow_internet=true` solely for Harbor 0.24 Docker startup under the user's explicit authorization for new63; no business rule, gold, verifier or fixture changed.

Revision 0.1.2 (2026-10-30): Gold partitions the active dependency graph into independent components, prunes impossible domains and unreachable packages, and selects/counts feasible locks per component; minimal root conflicts are likewise scoped to components. The valid input domain is unchanged. The verifier retains its independently written exhaustive reference on small catalogs and adds mathematical expected outputs for 27 independent packages (feasible and blocked) and a 1100-package required chain. This addresses the confirmed 122-second timeout on a 27-package empty-root case without an arbitrary input cap. Exact feasible counting for a single highly coupled component remains combinatorial in the worst case, so this revision makes no universal 120-second guarantee. No external source or data was introduced; the catalog v0.1.1 tree SHA remains the audit baseline.

tasks.title: 配额申诉后各项分配的变动频率

source.notice:
# Inclusion and provenance

- 加入理由：在有限人造单元上同时考验严格输入契约、精确分数迭代、确定性整数分配和跨维审计，适合自然分工与汇合。
- 来源：项目原创合成任务；固定版本 2026-10-26-v0.1.1；无外部样本、个人数据或现成 benchmark 题面复制。v0.1.1 补中途结构零及已有输出保护测试，并依据用户明确授权启用容器网络。
- 许可证：项目发布许可证待定；外部输入与依赖为 Python 标准库及固定 Python 基础镜像，镜像许可证随上游。
- 改编方式：无公开 benchmark 题目改编；思想为通用比例调整及最大余数分配，但合同、夹具、判分为原创。
- 能力：schema、分数运算、迭代状态、确定性 tie、边际守恒、CLI 工程。
- 复杂度：2–3 维、最多 10 单元、最多 3 轮；难度来自跨阶段规则和边界，5–20 分钟为设计假说，尚未实测。
- 预计可并行机会：输入审计、分数更新、整数分配、边际/摘要核验可分模块推进，在端到端集成时汇合。未强制 Agent DAG。
- 网络与资源：业务完全离线，1 CPU/少量内存即可；用户已明确授权 new66–100 正式任务及免费 oracle 副本的容器网络，任务 `allow_internet=true`。业务测试不得下载数据。
- 污染：全新合成数据、动态隐藏改变维度/类别/单元结构；固定公开值硬编码应失败。通用算法知识可用，不把训练集包含情况当作已知。
- Verifier：独立参考按不同循环路径用 Fraction 计算；公开+动态+定向有效与非法；no-op、定向错解、组合错解；输入不可变与字节稳定。
- 节点规模：数据单元不是 Agent 语义工作包，不声称千 Agent 节点。
